```python
# Log in to Spotify
passwords = apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords()
spotify_password = next(p["password"] for p in passwords if p["account_name"] == "spotify")
login_result = apis.spotify.login(username="deniseburch@gmail.com", password=spotify_password)
spotify_access_token = login_result["access_token"]

# Load all playlists from the library
all_playlists = []
page_index = 0
while True:
    page = apis.spotify.show_playlist_library(
        access_token=spotify_access_token,
        page_index=page_index,
        page_limit=20
    )
    if not page:
        break
    all_playlists.extend(page)
    page_index += 1

# Collect unique song ids across all playlists
unique_song_ids = set()
for playlist in all_playlists:
    for song_id in playlist.get("song_ids", []):
        unique_song_ids.add(song_id)

# Count artists by unique songs
artist_counts = {}
for song_id in unique_song_ids:
    song = apis.spotify.show_song(access_token=spotify_access_token, song_id=song_id)
    artist_info = song.get("artist")
    if isinstance(artist_info, list):
        artist_names = [a.get("name") for a in artist_info if a.get("name")]
    elif isinstance(artist_info, dict):
        artist_names = [artist_info.get("name")] if artist_info.get("name") else []
    else:
        artist_names = []

    for artist_name in artist_names:
        artist_counts[artist_name] = artist_counts.get(artist_name, 0) + 1

top_6_artists = [name for name, _ in sorted(artist_counts.items(), key=lambda x: (-x[1], x[0]))[:6]]
answer = ", ".join(top_6_artists)
print(answer)

apis.supervisor.complete_task(answer=answer)
```
